content: NIP-29 is draft/optional and defines relay-enforced read/write access, not content encryption. Group identity is relay plus id; durability depends on relay and spec recommends a live replica. Roles and their capabilities are relay policy. Private means only members may read; hidden only hides discovery. Pyramid root can read all groups, and current Pyramid accepts plaintext group events with h tags. Client relay routing and authorization must be tested with canaries.
